body:
Greptile Summary

This PR introduces `totalTokensEstimate` as a new `SessionEntry` field to preserve the last known positive token count for display purposes when a provider (e.g. vLLM) reports a zero-usage response. It threads the new field through all three session-update paths (`session-store.ts`, `session-usage.ts`, `cron/isolated-agent/run.ts`), all display surfaces (TUI, gateway rows, `/sessions`, `/status`), and all reset/new-session code paths. After an extensive multi-round review the logic is largely correct and consistent. Key changes: - New `hasExplicitUsage` helper (`v >= 0`) distinguishes an all-zero report from a missing report without semantic confusion around `hasNonzeroUsage`. - `totalTokensEstimate` is backfilled on first zero-usage run, preserved on subsequent zero-usage runs (guarded against consecutive writes with `prevEstimate ?? prevTotal`), and cleared on model change. - `resolveFreshSessionTotalTokens` correctly returns `undefined` for stale zero totals, allowing downstream consumers to fall back to the estimate. - `resolveGatewaySessionTotalTokens` (new helper) formalises the gateway fallback chain with a clear priority order. - `usedEstimate` guard in the gateway row builder correctly prevents an estimate-backed value from being marked `totalTokensFresh = true` via transcript coincidence. One remaining concern: the transcript fallback in `buildStatusMessage` (`status.ts`) gates on `entry?.totalTokensFresh === undefined`, which is stricter than the stated intent ("store has no fresh data"). Sessions whose freshness was explicitly cleared to `false` (e.g. after a model change or runner reset) are silently excluded even when they have no estimate and no fresh total, causing mid-run `/status` checks to show `0 / 128K` in those cases — a regression from the pre-PR `!totalTokens || candidate > totalTokens` logic. See inline comment for details. Additionally, the new `resolveGatewaySessionTotalTokens` function still carries duplicate `// 5.` step labels in its fallback chain, which the developer had indicated were addressed in a prior reply.

Confidence Score: 4/5

- PR is safe to merge with one targeted fix remaining: the over-restrictive transcript fallback guard in `status.ts` can cause mid-run `/status` to show `0 / 128K` after model changes. - After many review iterations, nearly all previously flagged issues have been resolved: the `totalTokensEstimate` field is consistently propagated, the three update paths (session-store, session-usage, cron runner) are aligned, the gateway `usedEstimate` guard is correct, and the estimate-backfill logic handles consecutive zero-usage runs. The one remaining issue is the `totalTokensFresh === undefined` transcript guard in `status.ts`, which is more restrictive than the stated intent and produces an observable regression (shows `0 / 128K` instead of a live transcript estimate) for mid-run status checks after a model change. This is a P2 concern rather than a blocker for the primary fix, but it is a clear behavioural regression worth addressing before merge. - src/auto-reply/status.ts — transcript fallback guard condition on line ~648

Comments Outside Diff (1)

 1. `src/auto-reply/status.ts`, line 648-656 ([link](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/85534021e22c9169a2de0a04e98946dbd716bb01/src/auto-reply/status.ts#L648-L656)) **Transcript fallback over-restricted for post-model-change sessions** The fourth guard `entry?.totalTokensFresh === undefined` was added to prevent stale transcript values from overriding a preserved estimate. However, it also silently blocks the transcript fallback for sessions whose freshness was explicitly cleared to `false` (e.g., after a model change in `session-store.ts` / `sessions/model-overrides.ts`), even when those sessions have no estimate and no fresh data. Concretely, for a mid-run status check immediately after a model override: - `totalTokensFresh = false` (cleared by model-change logic) - `totalTokensEstimate = undefined` (cleared by model-change logic) - `freshTotal = undefined` - `totalTokens` initialises to `0` (no I/O tokens either) - Transcript has live data for the current run, e.g. `candidate = 4 500` - Condition fires on `entry?.totalTokensFresh === undefined` → **`false`** → transcript is skipped Result: status shows `Context: 0 / 128K` instead of the live estimate, a regression from the old `!totalTokens || totalTokens === 0 || candidate > totalTokens` logic. The inline comment says "store has no fresh data", but `totalTokensFresh === undefined` actually means "was never set" — the two conditions are not equivalent. A guard that also allows sessions with `false` freshness but no estimate would match the stated intent: Or, more directly, remove the fourth condition entirely — it adds no value once the `freshTotal === undefined` and `entry?.totalTokensEstimate === undefined` guards are in place, since those already prevent the transcript from overriding a valid preserved estimate.
Prompt To Fix All With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Path: src/auto-reply/status.ts Line: 648-656 Comment: **Transcript fallback over-restricted for post-model-change sessions** The fourth guard `entry?.totalTokensFresh === undefined` was added to prevent stale transcript values from overriding a preserved estimate. However, it also silently blocks the transcript fallback for sessions whose freshness was explicitly cleared to `false` (e.g., after a model change in `session-store.ts` / `sessions/model-overrides.ts`), even when those sessions have no estimate and no fresh data. Concretely, for a mid-run status check immediately after a model override: - `totalTokensFresh = false` (cleared by model-change logic) - `totalTokensEstimate = undefined` (cleared by model-change logic) - `freshTotal = undefined` - `totalTokens` initialises to `0` (no I/O tokens either) - Transcript has live data for the current run, e.g. `candidate = 4 500` - Condition fires on `entry?.totalTokensFresh === undefined` → **`false`** → transcript is skipped Result: status shows `Context: 0 / 128K` instead of the live estimate, a regression from the old `!totalTokens || totalTokens === 0 || candidate > totalTokens` logic. The inline comment says "store has no fresh data", but `totalTokensFresh === undefined` actually means "was never set" — the two conditions are not equivalent. A guard that also allows sessions with `false` freshness but no estimate would match the stated intent: ```suggestion if ( logUsage.totalTokensFresh && freshTotal === undefined && (entry?.totalTokensEstimate === undefined || (candidate > 0 && hasZeroEstimate)) && (entry?.totalTokensFresh === undefined || entry.totalTokensFresh === false) ) { ``` Or, more directly, remove the fourth condition entirely — it adds no value once the `freshTotal === undefined` and `entry?.totalTokensEstimate === undefined` guards are in place, since those already prevent the transcript from overriding a valid preserved estimate. How can I resolve this? If you propose a fix, please make it concise. `````
